neighbours.label: the article ' a' / ' an' / ' A' right after write / writing / compose, where a kind of written piece is about to be named ('write a | letter', 'Writing A | Summary'); its output promotes genre words (story, research, persuasive, cover). 'a' after read, bake, build or draw stays low
fire: Before the holidays, every pupil had to write a letter to the mayor.
This guide explains the basics of writing a persuasive speech.
Ten Steps To Writing An Outstanding Personal Statement
After the trip she decided to write a memoir about her years abroad.
Most applicants struggle when asked to write an abstract in 200 words.
Lesson 4: How To Write A Book Review
My editor suggested writing a sequel while readers still cared.
As a final task, students write a short report on their findings.
quiet: Before the holidays, every pupil had to read a letter from the mayor.
This guide explains the basics of giving a persuasive speech.
Ten Steps To Baking An Outstanding Apple Pie
After the trip she decided to buy a house near her parents.
Most applicants struggle when asked to draw a map in two minutes.
Lesson 4: How To Build A Bird Feeder
My editor suggested taking a holiday while the weather held.
As a final task, students plant a small tree in the garden.

notes: Card: ' a' x16, ' an' x4, ' A' x3 of the top 32, all after write/writing/Write (Writing A Summary, writing an equation, write a letter); logit effect promotes ' creative', ' research', ' storytelling', ' cover', ' story', ' persuasive', ' dialogue', ' academic'. Probes: 'How To Write A' 0.64, 'writing an essay' 0.51, 'write a short story' 0.49, 'write me a poem' 0.36, 'compose a letter' 0.34; 'read a short story' 0.13, 'writing the report' 0.16, 'bake a cake' 0.04, 'build a house' 0.004. It also fired at 0.71 on ' and' in 'forms of poetry, including sonnets and', so the broader reading is 'a genre of writing is about to be named'; the test is on the article case. The - pole fires where a specific work or text is already being referred to ('a piece of writing', 'The Crucible by Arthur'): naming a kind of writing versus pointing at an actual text.
